_comment: The picture the dealers' pins stand on. Every dealer's mapX/mapY is a fraction of this picture, measured from
its top left, so replacing the picture means re-reading every pin off it. The last mod's map is the one shown.
The picture is the Automobile Club of Southern California's road map of Los Angeles and Vicinity, 2444 x 1560.
It reaches out to Victorville and Joshua Tree, most of it desert with nothing to sell a car in, so the anchor
is the inhabited corner: the valley and the coast across to Riverside. The anchor is what must be on screen, as
fractions of the whole picture; the screen grows out of it to the window's shape, so a wider window sees more.
